fit.summary: Eleven years of teaching, led an NGSS unit rewrite, and mentors student teachers; not National Board certified.

cover_letter.hook: Coaching science teachers through the Next Generation Science Standards is work I have been doing from my own classroom, and I would like to do it full time for Coburg Ridge School District.
cover_letter.body:
At Larkspur Middle School I led the 3-teacher science team that rewrote our 8th grade units to the Next Generation Science Standards, and I have mentored 4 student teachers through full-term placements. Over three years, weekly lab write-ups with a shared rubric raised the share of my students meeting the state science standard from 54% to 68%.

I also started our family science night, which grew from 80 to 400 attendees, and published 30 demonstration guides that other schools now use (example.com/gholloway/science-night). Before Larkspur I taught 5th grade for five years and coached 5 colleagues through a new math curriculum.
cover_letter.close: I would like to hear how your coaches split their time between new teachers and department-wide unit work.

gaps: National Board Certification is preferred; Grace does not hold it.
